in_hebrew.name: Irv
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Fern or ruler of the elk forest
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Irv הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The Old High German name Irwino was composed of the elements irw, meaning 'fern' or 'ruler', and wino, meaning 'friend' or 'forest' or 'wood'. The name Irv is derived from this Germanic name. It was popularized in the English-speaking world due to the influence of the Anglo-Saxon culture.
